sloka: शीघ्रं निर्यान्तु दुर्धर्षा राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः ।अकम्पनं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वशस्त्रप्रकोविदम् ।। ६.५५.२ ।।।।
transliteration: śīghraṁ niryāntu durdharṣā rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ ।akampanaṁ puraskṛtya sarvaśastraprakovidam ।। 6.55.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "Send for Akampana quickly, who is of terrific valour, difficult to encounter and skilled in all sastras."
